title: Hearty Gooey Jamaican Yam Casserole
description: A festive Jamaican dish featuring pecorino-romano and tadka, this casserole is a low-calorie-friendly twist on traditional cuisine. It combines the natural sweetness of yams with the savory flavors of Jamaican spices.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large skillet, heat the coconut oil over medium heat and saute the onion and garlic until softened.
Add the tadka spice blend, scotch bonnet peppers, salt, and black pepper to the skillet and stir for 1 minute.
Add the diced yams to the skillet and stir to combine with the spice mixture.
Transfer the yam mixture to a 9x13 inch baking dish and top with crumbly pecorino-romano cheese.
Bake the casserole in the preheated oven for 45 minutes, or until the yams are tender and the top is golden brown.
Remove the casserole from the oven and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
Serve the casserole hot, garnished with chopped fresh herbs if desired.
